# Delivery plan

The program has **1 program, 12 epics and 60 work packages** as native issues, with **124 checklist tasks and 284 subtasks** and **84 prerequisite links**. Project [#11](https://github.com/orgs/Pick-Your-AI/projects/11) tracks 1095 initial field values.

Planning is not implementation: every work package starts in Backlog and is accepted only through its own reviewed pull request.
